title: Acoustic-to-Text KV Compression for Full-Duplex Speech Models
title_zh: 面向全双工语音模型的声学到文本 KV 压缩
abstract_en: Full-duplex speech language models continuously accumulate acoustic key-value (KV) states, making long-running interactions memory-intensive. During listening, the model can finish processing an audio unit before the next arrives; we term the remaining interval listening-time slack. We propose acoustic-to-text KV compression, which introduces a transcription side channel to convert incoming speech into compact textual memory within this interval. When the cache exceeds a target budget during inference, older acoustic states are evicted while transcripts and recent acoustic context remain. We train the side channel with LoRA using cross-entropy on transcription segments. To preserve listening and speaking behavior, we apply knowledge distillation to the original model's token-level output distributions at native prediction positions. On ten-minute LongSpeech sessions, our MiniCPM-o 4.5 implementation reduces peak streaming KV-cache size by 64.6% compared with the same model without eviction. The proposed method also improves transcription, temporal question answering, and summarization over the baseline. Full-Duplex-Bench evaluations further show comparable pause-handling, turn-taking, and interruption performance.
abstract_zh: 全双工语音语言模型会持续累积声学 KV 状态，导致长时间交互中的显存占用不断增加。论文利用模型在连续音频单元之间的 listening-time slack，引入 transcription side channel，将输入语音转换为紧凑文本记忆。当 KV cache 超过目标预算时，淘汰较早的声学状态，仅保留转录文本和近期声学上下文。该 side channel 使用 LoRA，并通过转录片段的交叉熵训练；同时在模型原生预测位置上进行知识蒸馏，以保持听取和发言行为。在十分钟 LongSpeech 会话中，基于 MiniCPM-o 4.5 的实现将峰值流式 KV-cache 大小降低 64.6%，并在转录、时序问答和摘要任务上优于无淘汰基线。Full-Duplex-Bench 结果表明，该方法在停顿处理、轮次交接和打断响应方面保持了相近性能。
key_points_zh: 提出 acoustic-to-text KV compression，通过 transcription side channel 将历史语音压缩为文本记忆。
利用 listening-time slack 在实时推理间隙完成转录，并在超出预算时淘汰旧 acoustic KV states。
采用 LoRA 训练转录通道，并用 token-level knowledge distillation 保持原模型的听说行为。
在十分钟 LongSpeech 会话中，MiniCPM-o 4.5 的峰值流式 KV-cache 降低 64.6%。
该方法提升 transcription、temporal question answering 和 summarization，同时保持 Full-Duplex-Bench 中的交互能力。

llm_assessment.comment: Acoustic-to-text KV compression addresses a central scalability bottleneck for long-running full-duplex speech agents while preserving interruption and turn-taking behavior.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 声学到文本的KV压缩解决了长时全双工语音智能体的关键扩展性瓶颈，同时保持了打断处理和轮次交互能力。
